title: Stable inheritance of the Streptomyces linear plasmid SCP1 by dual ParAB S partition systems
authors: McPhillips L; Chandra G; McLean TC; Tran NT; Le TBK
one_liner_zh: 该文研究链霉菌线性质粒SCP1的双ParAB分区系统，涉及ParB蛋白与DNA的互作和CTPase功能，但核心是质粒遗传维持而非TF-DNA转录结合，且方法以实验为主，无AI或物理模拟建模，故匹配度较低。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Low-copy-number plasmids often rely on dedicated maintenance mechanisms, such as partitioning systems, to ensure stable inheritance across generations. These partition systems actively segregate sister plasmid copies during cell division and are classified by the NTPase types they encode. While the distribution and organization of partition system types are well characterized in Enterobacteriaceae plasmids, their functions and diversity across broader bacterial taxa remain poorly understood. Here, we analyze a large and diverse plasmid database to examine the distribution of partition system types and find that plasmids encoding multiple partition systems are more common than previously recognized. Notably, many plasmids encode multiple partition systems of the same type, an organization that has not been previously investigated. To further investigate, we employ the Streptomyces linear plasmid SCP1, which encodes two type I ATP- and CTP-dependent parABS partition systems, as a model. Sequence analysis shows that both SCP1-encoded ParBs harbor less conserved CTPase domains than their chromosomal counterparts, suggesting they might diverge from canonical ParB functions. However, using chromatin immunoprecipitation with deep sequencing, biochemical assays, and targeted mutagenesis, we demonstrate that both proteins are bona fide ParB CTPase proteins: they recognize distinct parS sites on SCP1, bind and hydrolyze CTP, and slide to accumulate on DNA. Despite both systems being functional, only parABS1 , but not parABS2 , is crucial for SCP1 maintenance under standard laboratory conditions. Altogether, these findings provide the first functional characterization of dual ParB-CTPase partition systems coexisting on a single plasmid, advancing our understanding of plasmid maintenance in Streptomyces, and reveal new aspects of the diversity and distribution of plasmid partition systems in bacteria.
abstract_zh:
摘要

低拷贝数质粒通常依赖专门的维持机制（如分配系统）以确保跨代稳定遗传。这些分配系统在细胞分裂过程中主动分离姐妹质粒拷贝，并根据其编码的NTPase类型进行分类。尽管分配系统类型在肠杆菌科（Enterobacteriaceae）质粒中的分布和组织已得到充分表征，但其在更广泛细菌类群中的功能和多样性仍知之甚少。在此，我们分析了一个大型且多样化的质粒数据库，以检查分配系统类型的分布，并发现编码多个分配系统的质粒比先前认识的更为普遍。值得注意的是，许多质粒编码同一类型的多个分配系统，这种组织方式此前未被研究过。为进一步探究，我们以链霉菌（Streptomyces）线性质粒SCP1为模型，其编码两个I型ATP和CTP依赖的parABS分配系统。序列分析显示，SCP1编码的两个ParB蛋白的CTPase结构域比其染色体对应物保守性更低，表明它们可能偏离典型的ParB功能。然而，通过染色质免疫沉淀结合深度测序、生化测定和靶向诱变，我们证明这两种蛋白均为真正的ParB CTPase蛋白：它们识别SCP1上不同的parS位点，结合并水解CTP，并滑动以在DNA上积累。尽管这两个系统均有功能，但在标准实验室条件下，仅parABS1（而非parABS2）对SCP1的维持至关重要。总体而言，这些发现提供了首个关于单一质粒上共存的双ParB-CTPase分配系统的功能表征，推进了我们对链霉菌中质粒维持的理解，并揭示了细菌中质粒分配系统多样性和分布的新方面。
